note: Invented sample truck thread, mail 1 of 3: the trucker pushes back on a liftgate at the delivery end.
subject: RE: Dayton OH - Knoxville TN / dry van dispatch
body:
Eric,

Our price only covers a liftgate on the pickup side; nobody asked us for a liftgate at the Knoxville end, and they have a dock there, so we won't add one for this money.

Nora
